caption: The drawing depicts a single open wallet or card holder positioned diagonally across a plain, off-white background. The wallet is rendered in shades of brown, reddish-brown, and beige, featuring visible textural details suggesting a worn fabric or leather material. The inside of the wallet shows two main interior compartments, one of which includes a scalloped edge with evenly spaced holes. The rectangular wallet’s exterior is decorated with a border pattern, and the inside sections have similar, faded decorative patterns. In the upper right corner of the page, there are small, hand-drawn pencil measurements, including a notation for “5 1/2” and a scale reference “1/8 = 1.” There are also two distinct brown stains or marks, one in the top right corner and one in the bottom right corner of the page. The overall composition centers the wallet with ample empty space around it.
title: Wallet
